An Extreme Heat Warning is issued for Thursday with heat indices up to 112°F in the region; Heat Advisory expected for Austin. incidents.title: AutoZone Robbery-Homicide — E. Riverside Dr (Suspect At Large)
incidents.location: 2300 blk E. Riverside Dr / AutoZone parking lot (~1.5 mi SE)
incidents.detail: APD is investigating the robbery-homicide of Jose Salgado-Amador, 28, who was working as a mechanic in the AutoZone parking lot at 2300 E. Riverside Dr when a suspect confronted him, demanded property, shot him, and fled. Incident: Monday June 16, approximately 10:47 PM. Victim transported to hospital and later died — Austin's 27th homicide of 2026. SUSPECT: Hispanic male, approximately 15-20 years old, wearing a gray hoodie, fled in a light-colored sedan — at large as of 0500 CDT June 17. This location is approximately 1.5 mi SE of the property on E. Riverside corridor (also Rainey St access corridor). Brief security staff and valet; report suspect sightings to APD: 512-477-3588 or Crime Stoppers: (512) 472-8477.

incidents.title: Double Homicide — Oltorf St SE Austin (Husband/Wife; Active Investigation)
incidents.location: 4700 blk Oltorf St, SE Austin (~2.5 mi SE)
incidents.detail: APD is investigating Austin's 28th homicide of 2026 — a husband and wife found dead at 4700 block Oltorf St following a welfare check on June 16. Officers responded at 6:20 PM, found both deceased inside the residence. An aggressive dog delayed entry; no weapon information released; investigation active. No nexus to property identified. Location is 2.5 mi SE in a residential area. Staff awareness — no property action required; monitor for any updates that change proximity assessment.

incidents.title: I-35 Hit-and-Run Homicide — APD Vehicular Homicide (Active)
incidents.location: 600 blk N. I-35 Southbound Service Road (~0.4 mi E)
incidents.detail: APD Vehicular Homicide Unit continues investigation of fatal hit-and-run from Friday June 13 (~11:35 PM) at 600 block N. I-35 southbound service road. Suspect vehicle: 2011-2015 gray or silver Hyundai Sonata, front-end damage, missing right headlight — at large as of 0500 CDT. No arrest made. Brief valet and security staff to report sightings to APD non-emergency: (512) 974-5000.

incidents.title: Extreme Heat Warning — Thursday June 18 (Heat Index Up to 112°F)
incidents.detail: NWS Austin/San Antonio has issued an Extreme Heat Warning for portions of Central Texas from noon to 8 PM CDT Thursday June 18. Dangerously hot conditions with heat index values up to 112°F expected. This is the first significant heat event of summer 2026 — risk is higher as populations have had little time to acclimatize. Today (Wednesday): High 92°F, heat index up to 103°F — already hazardous for prolonged outdoor activity. PROPERTY ACTIONS: Activate heat protocol for all outdoor staff today; pre-position hydration stations poolside and at valet; review heat illness SOP and escalation; brief AM shift on heat index criteria for outdoor operations. Do NOT restore full outdoor F&B/pool service without confirming cooling stations available. High bacteria levels in area waterways — no swimming in open water.

incidents.title: US-Iran MOU — Formal Signing Friday at Burgenstock, Switzerland
incidents.detail: The US-Iran MOU formal signing ceremony is confirmed for Friday June 19 at Burgenstock resort, Switzerland (venue changed from Geneva for security reasons; G7 summit was in nearby Evian, France). VP Vance and Iranian Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf will sign. Key MOU terms per Bloomberg draft: oil sanctions waived immediately on signing; $300B reconstruction fund; US lifts naval blockade immediately; Iran resumes commercial shipping within 30 days; 60-day negotiation window on nuclear program begins. Text disputed — both sides claiming victory. Trump says Strait of Hormuz 'completely open' once signed; 'ships already loading.' Austin relevance: Iranian cyber threat continues declining; maintain zero-click, zero-QR posture through Friday signing. After signing: posture can begin normalizing if no retaliatory incidents. Juneteenth Week Friday + MOU signing = potential Iranian diaspora gatherings near UT/downtown Friday.

incidents.title: Business Jet Crash — Laredo, TX (Austin-Bound Flight)
incidents.location: Loop 20, Laredo TX (~150 mi SW) — National/state context
incidents.detail: A NetJets Cessna Citation Latitude business jet en route to Austin from San Jose del Cabo, Mexico, declared a mechanical emergency and crash-landed on Loop 20 in Laredo Tuesday evening (~10 PM). The aircraft lost communication with ATC and struck a moving vehicle on the highway. 1 fatality; multiple injured including 5 responding officers transported to hospital. FBI, NTSB, and FAA on scene. Passengers from an Austin-bound aircraft — potential disruption to incoming guests if passengers were Four Seasons-bound. NTSB investigation underway. Monitor for any guest inquiries about the incident or disrupted itineraries.

Annual Juneteenth Parade scheduled Friday June 19, 9:30 AM - 12:00 PM, East Austin — parade route expected to generate street closures near Rosewood Park area. Austin Resource Recovery seeking volunteers along parade route. Generally peaceful, celebratory events through the week. Juneteenth federal holiday Friday — federal offices closed. Guest inquiries about Juneteenth events should be directed to concierge. Monitor East Austin for any street closure advisories ahead of Friday parade.
